requirements.general_text: Entry Level and Requirements Foundation: Matriculation or Foundation Certificate with CGPA 2.0 Diploma: A relevant diploma with a CGPA of at least 2.00 from another institution STPM: Grade C (GP2.0) in any 2 subjects, and a pass in Mathematics and English A-Level: 2 Grade D in any subjects AND pass in Mathematics and English UEC: 5 subjects at grade B including a pass in Mathematics and English SACE: 4 or 5 subjects with ATAR 55 AND pass in Mathematics and English NSW (HSC): 10 units with ATAR 55 AND pass in Mathematics and English CPU: 6 passes with an average of 55 TEE: 4 or 5 subjects with ATAR 55 AND pass in Mathematics and English Australian Year 12: TER/UAI/ENTER 55 STAM: Grade Jayyid and pass Mathematics and English Others: Other equivalent qualifications as recognised by the government of Malaysia
